security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost blob: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: See which apps talk to the internet on a 3D globe
bundle.longDescription: Network Cartographer is a desktop app that shows which applications on your machine talk to the internet, where they connect, and traceroute paths to each remote host — visualized on a live 3D globe. Monitoring is local; optional GeoIP lookups may contact third-party APIs unless you use a local MaxMind database.
